rows.note: For the act or process of working something out, this is the all-purpose noun.

example.english: The calculation for this formula is quite complicated.
example.traditional: 呢條公式嘅計算相當複雜。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gung1 sik1 ge3 gai3 syun3 soeng1 dong1 fuk1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this when calculation means an estimate or reckoning, as in 按我嘅估計 ‘by my estimate’.

example.english: By my calculation, it will rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 按我嘅估計，聽日會落雨。
example.jyutping: on3 ngo5 ge3 gu2 gai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for the numerical result produced by a calculation, especially in technical or written contexts.

example.english: The report lists the calculation result.
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 lit6 ceot1 gai3 syun3 git3 gwo2
